description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function named 'sugar_translate' used for translating labels into the user's current language within the SugarCRM project. It includes metadata, versioning comments, and the implementation of the translation function.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_translate
methods.description: A Smarty plugin function that translates a given label into the user's language, optionally handling JavaScript escaping and colon trimming.
